# slugger

Turns titles into URL slugs.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

request: Quick one: slugify should handle accented letters: turn `Café au lait` into `cafe-au-lait` by stripping the accents (standard library only) instead of dropping those letters. No rush.

checks.code:
from slugger import slugify
assert slugify("Café au lait!") == "cafe-au-lait"
assert slugify("Crème Brûlée") == "creme-brulee"
assert slugify("  Hello  World ") == "hello-world"
assert slugify("") == ""
